intro.en: Before I start, I'd like to ask you up to 10 quick multiple-choice questions, so I use your library the way you want. You can skip any question, and you can change any answer later just by telling me.
intro.zh: 开始之前，我想问你最多 10 个简单的选择题，好按你想要的方式用你的库。任何一题都可以跳过；以后想改，直接告诉我就行。

outro.en: Thank you. None of this is fixed: tell me any time if you want to change an answer. I'll check the permission and privacy answers with you again in about 3 months, how often to review in about 2 months, how to ask you in about 4 months, and the rest in about 6 months.
outro.zh: 谢谢。这些都不是定死的，随时告诉我想改哪一条。权限和隐私相关的几题，我大约 3 个月后再跟你确认一次；多久看一次整理建议，大约 2 个月后确认；怎么问你拿主意，大约 4 个月后确认；其余的大约半年确认一次。

ask.en: What do you mainly want me to use your library for? Pick any that fit.
ask.zh: 你主要想让我用这个库做什么？可以多选。

why.en: This decides which features I turn on for you.
why.zh: 这决定我为你打开哪些功能。

options.en: Remember what you tell me: preferences, decisions, facts about you
options.zh: 记住你告诉我的事：偏好、决定、关于你的事实

options.en: Organize the notes you already have
Collect and connect what you read and learn
options.zh: 收集、串联你读到和学到的东西

options.en: Keep track of work: projects, decisions, people you work with
options.zh: 管工作上的事：项目、决定、合作的人

options.en: Get to know you deeply over time (values, how you think), so I can act more like you would
options.zh: 慢慢深入了解你（价值观、思考方式），做事越来越像你会做的那样

options.en: Something else (tell me in your own words)

ask.en: Which parts of your life will the library cover? Pick any that fit.
ask.zh: 这个库会涉及你生活的哪些方面？可以多选。

why.en: This tells me where to file things, and which areas may need extra privacy.
why.zh: 这让我知道东西该放哪里，以及哪些方面可能要更注意隐私。

options.en: Work and career
Study and research
Family and home life
Health and fitness
Money and finances
Hobbies and interests
Relationships and the people in your life
Something else (tell me)

ask.en: Do you already have notes somewhere?
ask.zh: 你现在已经有笔记了吗？在哪里？

why.en: If you do, I can read them as they are; I won't rewrite them.
why.zh: 如果有，我可以原样读，不会改写它们。

options.en: No, let's start fresh
Yes, a folder of Markdown or text files (for example Obsidian or Logseq)
options.zh: 有，一个 Markdown 或文本文件夹（比如 Obsidian、Logseq）

options.en: Yes, in another app (Notion, Apple Notes, Evernote, OneNote...) that can export
options.zh: 有，在别的应用里（Notion、备忘录、印象笔记、OneNote 等），可以导出

options.en: Scattered across chats, emails and documents
options.zh: 散在聊天记录、邮件和文档里

options.en: Something else (tell me)

ask.en: How much may I change your notes?
ask.zh: 我可以在多大程度上改你的笔记？

why.en: This is the main permission setting. Your most important pages always need your yes, whatever you pick.
why.zh: 这是最主要的权限设置。不管选哪项，最重要的几页改动永远要你点头。

options.en: Only read them. Never change or add anything.
options.zh: 只读，不改也不加任何东西

options.en: Write what you learn into a separate inbox; I'll go through it myself
options.zh: 把你学到的记在单独的收件箱里，我自己去看

options.en: Suggest changes, and change my notes only after I say yes
options.zh: 提出修改建议，我说可以了再改

options.en: Add small, low-risk things (like journal entries) directly; ask me for everything else
options.zh: 小的、低风险的补充（比如日记）直接加，其余的先问我

options.en: Make most additions directly and tell me afterwards
options.zh: 大部分补充直接做，事后告诉我

ask.en: What should I write down? Each option includes the ones above it.
ask.zh: 我该记下哪些东西？每一项都包含它上面的几项。

why.en: I always label who said what: your words, my guesses, and outside sources are kept apart.
why.zh: 我永远会标明来源：你的原话、我的推测、外部资料分开记。

options.en: Only what I explicitly ask you to remember
Important things I say: preferences, decisions, facts
options.zh: 我说过的重要的事：偏好、决定、事实

options.en: Also your own observations about me, always marked as your guess
options.zh: 再加上你对我的观察，永远标明是你的推测

options.en: Also useful outside material (articles, web pages), always with the source
options.zh: 再加上有用的外部资料（文章、网页），永远注明出处

ask.en: Which topics are sensitive for you? Pick any that fit. (Passwords and keys are never stored, whatever you pick.)
ask.zh: 哪些话题对你来说比较敏感？可以多选。（密码和密钥无论如何都不会存。）

why.en: I'll treat these as private by default.
why.zh: 这些我会默认按私密处理。

options.en: Health
Money and accounts
Family matters and other people's private lives
Confidential work matters
Where you live and your daily routine
Nothing in particular
Something else (tell me)

ask.en: How should I handle sensitive things?
ask.zh: 敏感的内容该怎么处理？

why.en: Keeping them out is the simplest and safest. The vault is for people who want me to keep sensitive things too: it needs a small encryption tool installed, and you set a passphrase yourself in a terminal. I can put things in but can never read them.
why.zh: 完全不进库最简单，也最安全。保险箱适合想让我把敏感的事也记下来的人，需要另装一个加密小工具，再由你自己在终端里设一个口令；我能往里放，但永远读不了。

options.en: Keep them out of the library completely
Keep them in an encrypted vault that only I can open
options.zh: 放进加密保险箱，只有我能打开

options.en: Store them, but ask me before reading or using them
options.zh: 可以存，但读或用之前先问我

options.en: No special handling

ask.en: How often are you happy to spend a few minutes reviewing my suggestions?
ask.zh: 你愿意多久花几分钟看一下我的整理建议？

why.en: I'll batch my suggestions to match, so I don't interrupt you too often.
why.zh: 我会按这个节奏攒着建议一起给你，不频繁打扰。

options.en: Every day
Once a week
Once a month
Only when I ask

ask.en: When I need your input, how should I ask?
ask.zh: 需要你拿主意的时候，我该怎么问？

why.en: Some people like few questions, others like to be asked. Either is fine.
why.zh: 有人喜欢少被问，有人喜欢多问几句，都可以。

options.en: As little as possible: decide yourself and ask only about important things
options.zh: 尽量少问，你自己判断，重要的才问

options.en: Multiple choice, at most 3 questions at a time
options.zh: 出选择题，每次最多 3 道

options.en: Ask whenever you're unsure
Tell me your guess first, then I confirm or correct it
options.zh: 先说你的猜测，我来确认或纠正

why.en: With several agents or people, I can give each one only the parts they need.
why.zh: 如果有好几个助手或好几个人用，我可以只给每个人看他需要的部分。

options.en: Just me, with one AI assistant
options.zh: 只有我，加一个 AI 助手

options.en: Just me, but with several AI tools or agents
options.zh: 只有我，但会用好几个 AI 工具或助手

options.en: Family members or teammates will read parts of it
options.zh: 家人或同事也会看其中一部分

options.en: Not sure yet
